items.title: 67520_George Handy oral history interview
items.q: He stimulates me; he really opens the doors too. He opens them for me, baby, just the way I hope I open them for other people.

ctx.x: Some of the new people that I wasn't aware of, some of the things that had been recorded that I wasn't aware of.
I was looking through your records, which I guess is bad manners, like going through a bookcase, you've got a lot of Keith Jarrett there.
I love the way he plays. He stimulates me; he really opens the doors too. He opens them for me, baby, just the way I hope I open them for other people. This kid really is an astonishing musician.
